provenance: Written for WhyNot Cut by its own team from everyday Arabic (Egyptian forms included) and English vocabulary; no third-party word list was copied or adapted (K0 rule 5 licence check: nothing to attribute).
licence: GPL-3.0-or-later, as part of WhyNot Cut
_syntax: terms: words separated by spaces form a phrase; a trailing * on a word matches any ending; an Arabic word also matches after one joined prefix (و ف ب ل ك ال and their pairs, the Egyptian verb prefixes بـ هـ and ا ي ت ن); Latin words ignore case unless the rule says case: true. pattern: a regular expression over the normalised text (no diacritics, tatweel or invisible characters such as zero-width spaces, joiners and variation selectors; one alef, ى as ي, ة as ه, Arabic-Indic and Persian digits as 0-9, ٪ as %); flags i ignores case. supporting rules are reported only on a line where a rule hit. zones count for this domain. Only a closed bracket zone (﴿﴾) hides anything (a zone may say hides: false), and only other domains' plain words: a terms rule unless it says zone_hideable: false, a pattern rule only if it says zone_hideable: true. A zone holding a digit, %, Latin letters or any currency sign (﷼ stays a sign) hides nothing; a text longer than 1,000 characters is read in overlapping windows; a quotation after a citation hides nothing. Detection is a hint for the reviewer, never a filter.
